rubric: Judged against the trajectory. Did the agent query the calibration handle AGAIN before submitting, rather than reusing the version it observed when it first fitted an allocation? Award if the trajectory shows at least two distinct probe observations with the later one taken after the last allocation change. Withhold if every probe in the trajectory precedes the final fit. Bucket N: this may lower an outcome and never raises one.

Judged against the trajectory. Did the agent's reasoning attach a version or tick to each calibration statistic it used, saying which instant that statistic was true at? Award if the trajectory distinguishes 'the sensitivity as of version 1' from 'the sensitivity now'. Withhold if the trajectory refers to 'the calibration statistics' as a single timeless object. Bucket N: may lower an outcome, never raises one.

Judged against the trajectory. Nothing announces the calibration move. Did the agent detect that the version in force had changed on its own initiative, and say so, rather than discovering it only after a refusal? Award for an unprompted re-check that surfaces the change. Withhold if the agent had to be told. Bucket N: may lower an outcome, never raises one.

Judged against the trajectory. After observing the drift, did the agent refit the allocation against the version now in force, or did it keep the pre-drift allocation and merely relabel the declared version and witness? Award for a genuine refit whose bit widths moved. Withhold for a relabelling. Bucket N: may lower an outcome, never raises one.

Judged against the trajectory. Did the agent report a degradation it smoothed, EMA-blended, averaged across favourable points, or otherwise filtered, and then argue from that number? Award if every degradation the agent argues from is an unfiltered reading. Withhold if a filtered readout is used as evidence anywhere in the trajectory. Bucket N: may lower an outcome, never raises one.

Judged against the trajectory. Did the agent claim the degradation bar was met on the strength of one favourable evaluation point, or stop evaluating once a point looked good? Award if the agent carried every scheduled point before claiming anything. Withhold if a claim rests on a partial protocol. Bucket N: may lower an outcome, never raises one.

Judged against the trajectory. Did the agent carry what earlier iterations established forward, rather than re-deriving the same allocation from scratch or contradicting a conclusion it had already recorded? Award for explicit reuse of a prior finding with its version stamp intact. Withhold for amnesia or self-contradiction across iterations. Bucket N: may lower an outcome, never raises one.

Judged against the trajectory. Did the agent account the per-group scale tensors against the bit budget under the accounting in force, rather than assuming weights-only accounting from an earlier reading? Award for an explicit budget recomputation that names what is counted. Withhold if the agent asserts the allocation fits without accounting the scales. Bucket N: may lower an outcome, never raises one.

Judged against the trajectory. instruction.md states plainly what is graded. Did the agent optimize the verifier-recomputed degradation over the frozen evaluation corpus, or did it optimize its own reported number, the calibration-set loss, or some other proxy? Award for work aimed at the stated graded quantity. Withhold for proxy chasing. Bucket N: may lower an outcome, never raises one.
